name: calc-image
purpose: small-calc's calculation environment preinstalled and pinned in /opt/calc, so agent steps start computing at once instead of repairing a venv and pip-installing PySCF on every run
provides: /opt/calc/bin/python with pyscf 2.14.0, numpy 2.5.3, scipy 1.18.1, matplotlib 3.11.2, h5py 3.16.0

inputs.BASE_IMAGE: the macrae agent image (tasks/common), default ubuntu:24.04

outputs.image: a registry reference Modal can pull, e.g. ghcr.io/<owner>/macrae-calc:<date>

tests: python3 tasks/checks.py image-capability tasks/capabilities/calc-image (pins, hashes, policy)
docker build runs smoke.py: a Na+-water HF/STO-3G energy and a matplotlib figure (fails the build if broken)
build.sh runs smoke.py again in the built image

expected_effect.note: before = venv repair + pip install of the pinned stack measured on 2026-10-08 (130 s; the first Modal run lost ~60 s to the PySCF install alone, plus a failed venv); after = nothing to install once the image is pulled and cached by Modal. The dusk/dawn benchmark measures the real numbers.

created_by.note: the expected capability, written from the first Modal runs' lessons; the CREATE step's agent writes its own version, which this spec and checks.py image-capability judge
